record_scope_reconstruction: Greek farmer blockade prevented passenger and cargo vehicle movements through Evzoni–Bogorodica from January30 to February17,2017. Greek police locate the roadblock at km548 of Athens–Evzoni national road, starting15:00 January30, with diversion via Doirani. This is a Greek-side road obstruction, not the Macedonian customs building or nearby Idomeni railway.

source_checks.finding: Full February17 Duma/AMSM morning report inspected: all vehicle types still blocked; other regional road notices not part of this event.
Full one-page Greek Police table hosted by OFAE inspected: Kilkis row specifies km548 Athens–Evzoni road from15:00 January30 and Doirani alternative; unrelated road rows excluded.
Full OFAE February17 reopening notice inspected: Evzoni open for goods/passengers that morning, farmers withdrawing.
Direct OSM previously inspected in this pass: Greek freight-lane control node exists but does not establish km548 barricade or passenger scope; not assigned.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Bogorodica–Evzoni passenger and cargo vehicle blockade; geographic evidence applies only to this recorded scope.

date_scope_check.assessment: Canonical chronology retained. Duration, short/same-day status, uncertainty or contested dates are not geographic exclusions. No new endpoint inferred.
